description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Summon the Meeting to Appoint new Chairman to Fill the Vacants Post of Chairmen of Kinniya U/C, Kinniya P/S and Lahugala P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the summoning of meetings to appoint new Chairmen for local authorities (Kinniya Urban Council, Kinniya Pradeshiya Sabha, and Lahugala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including filling vacant elected positions, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7). While it mentions a government official (Commissioner of Local Government), the primary focus is on electoral procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
